fields.Name: IT123 - Feature Pipeline Key, Cache and Versions (core)
fields.Description: Deterministic server-side bundle 'feature-pipeline-core', sequence 49, ahead of the client-transport tests. Runs a Feature Pipeline against MJ core tables only (no bizapps-common) on a stub driver that answers from a table, so no model is called. FP1 the first run activates version 1 and writes one Feature Value per record; FP2 an identical second run changes nothing (upsert on the Feature Value key); FP3 two spellings of one value share one Dedup Cache row and one computation; FP4 an expired cache entry is recomputed once and refreshed in place; FP5 a version change holds scheduled runs until an on-demand run backfills it (v1 Retired, v2 Active); FP6 a dry run writes no cache, value, watermark or version rows; FP7 25 records skipped on their watermark plus 2 failures trip the error-rate breaker, because it counts attempted records only. Requires RUN_MUTATION_TESTS: every check writes a scratch pipeline (names and record IDs start with it123-), deleted at setup and teardown.

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: Seven checks pass: version 1 activates on the first run, an identical run is unchanged, two spellings share one cache row, an expired entry is refreshed in place, a version change holds scheduled runs until an on-demand backfill, a dry run writes nothing, and the breaker fails a run on its attempted records.
